XMLDB.COMMENT: Airpay Integrations: webhook + sync event log

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_integration_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Audit log of every inbound webhook + outbound sync event from KeKa, Teams, M365, and FCM. Append-only — read by the integrations admin dashboard.

FIELD.NAME: event_type
FIELD.COMMENT: Event type from the inbound payload (e.g. joiner|leaver|mover for KeKa)

FIELD.NAME: payload
FIELD.COMMENT: Raw inbound JSON payload — useful for replaying / debugging failures

INDEX.NAME: idx_source_status
INDEX.COMMENT: Find failures per source for the admin dashboard
